colecoes.descricao_html: Nightdresses and pajama sets engineered to move heat away from your skin, so you sleep through the night instead of waking up damp.
The complete sleep system: breathable sheets that pair with your Serena sleepwear for a cooler bed from every side.
Small additions that finish the ritual — a cooling eye mask, a soft slipper — easy add-ons at checkout.

produtos.descricao_html:
The Aurora is Serena's simplest nightdress — one layer of breathable, moisture-wicking fabric between you and a hot night. No lace to trap heat, no thick seams, just a relaxed cut that moves air instead of holding it against your skin.

  • Moisture-wicking fabric engineered to pull heat and sweat away from the body
  • Relaxed, non-binding fit — never clings when you're already warm
  • Machine washable, holds its softness wash after wash
  • True to size, S–XL

Designed for the nights when the room feels fine but you don't — restless legs, a flipped pillow, waking up at 3am. The Aurora is the first thing to change before you change anything else.
produtos.seo_titulo: Aurora Cooling Nightdress for Night Sweats | Serena Sleepwear
produtos.seo_descricao: Moisture-wicking nightdress engineered to keep you cool through hot flashes and night sweats. Free shipping over $150. 30-night comfort guarantee.

pdp.lede: You've flipped the pillow, changed the sheets, turned down the thermostat — and you're still waking up damp. The Aurora isn't another pajama. It's a different fabric.

Part of the Serena Air collection, the Breeze Sheet Set is built for the same restless, warm-natured sleepers who wear our cooling sleepwear — so your bed feels as fresh as your pajamas. Breathable fabric lets excess heat escape instead of trapping it against your skin.

Pairs naturally with any Serena cooling nightdress or pajama set for a complete cool-night system, from what you wear to what you sleep on.
